orchestration_findings.topic: ROOT CAUSE of the 8 a11y failures - verified by independent investigation
orchestration_findings.fact: apps/desktop/src/screens/SettingsScreen.tsx:318 renders Ledger (a ul role=list) whose direct child at :319 is Text (a span display:block), not an li. The e2e stub answers integrations.list with {ok:true,result:[]} (apps/desktop/e2e/harness.ts:1232) so integrations becomes [] not null (SettingsScreen.tsx:83-85), taking the live branch instead of the four-row SUBSCRIPTIONS branch at :275; integrations.map yields zero rows so the ul has no listitem child. Trigger (not the defect) was commit 08d61af adding integrations.list to the stub; the markup defect is older. Mechanism confirmed in axe-core source (node_modules/axe-core/axe.js:32152, :32138, :32089, :32118, :32128, :32213, :32131). Minimal fix: move the Text description out of Ledger to precede it in the Panel body, and render Ledger only when integrations.length > 0. The investigator argues pixel-neutrality (Panel body is a plain block div, ul has margin/padding 0 and border-block-start:none, .warsha-ledger scrollbar-gutter is inert with no overflow) but explicitly states the GATE must prove it, not the argument.
